APPROVE
The read loop moves into a `Reader` class whose methods each stay well under 15, and the logic is preserved: the trimmed-text `#` check matches the old one, line numbers are still `i + 1`, and branch order is unchanged. One assumption is that `IsDependencySection`, whose body the diff doesn't show, checks exactly `dependencies`, `devDependencies` and `optionalDependencies`; I couldn't build it, but nothing in the diff should add a warning.
